map.按年龄选择静息参考范围：<1 岁 30–60、1–<3 岁 24–40、3–<6: Select a resting reference range by age: <1 y 30–60, 1–<3 y 24–40, 3–<6 y 22–34, 6–<12 y 18–30, 12–<18 y 12–20, 18–<65 y 12–20, ≥65 y 12–20 breaths/min. Below the lower bound = bradypnoea (level 2), above the upper bound = tachypnoea (level 3), within range = normal (level 1); deviation = |rr − range midpoint|. Exercise state is not graded against resting ranges and only shows an exercise ceiling of 40 breaths/min. Validation: rr must be >0 and age/state are required, otherwise the result is cleared with a prompt.

map.正常呼吸频率是多少？: What is a normal respiratory rate?
map.成人静息约 12–20 次/分；>20 为呼吸过快（如发热、心衰、焦虑），<12: About 12-20 breaths/min at rest in adults; >20 is tachypnoea (e.g. fever, heart failure, anxiety) and <12 is bradypnoea (e.g. sedation, raised intracranial pressure); seek medical care if it persists.
map.偏离正常数有临床意义吗？: Is the deviation from normal clinically meaningful?
map.仅直观反映距对应年龄参考范围中值的程度（成人范围中值为 16）；真正判断看绝对值: It only gives an intuitive sense of how far you are from the midpoint of the age-specific range (16 for adults); the real judgement looks at the absolute value and accompanying symptoms (cyanosis, chest retraction, drowsiness). This tool does not replace a doctor.
map.仅直观反映距正常中值 16 的程度；真正判断看绝对值与伴随症状（发绀、胸陷、嗜睡: This only shows the distance from the normal midpoint (16); real assessment needs the absolute value and accompanying signs (cyanosis, retractions, lethargy). This tool does not replace a doctor.
